description_expanded: Scenic Stays 30A welcomes you to 17 Trigger Trail West, an ideal 30A location just steps from the beach. This coastal home welcomes you from the moment you arrive with its sunny yellow exterior and porches on two levels! Upon entry, guests will be greeted by a well-stocked kitchen perfect for making home-cooked meals or a quick snack to take to the beach. The open living space and dining room provide plenty of comfortable seating for all guests to relax after a long day. Enjoy beautiful sunrises and calming sunsets from the comforts of the multiple balconies. Refresh every night in one of the 3 three comfortable king bedrooms with en suite baths & private patios, while the kids relax in the twin bunk beds in the hallway or the two twin beds located in the loft area on the top floor. A spacious master suite with a private bath and an additional bedroom are located on the first floor along with hallway bunks and a full bath. This home does not allow pets, parties, or events of any kind, or guests under the age of 25 who are not accompanied by an adult chaperone. We look forward to greeting you at 17 Trigger Trail West as soon as your vacation begins - you'll leave ready to book your next experience with us! HIGHLIGHTS: *Less than 0.5 Mile to Private Beach Access *Complimentary Tram Service to Beach & Back (March - October) *0.3 Mile to 12,000 Sq Ft Lagoon Pool & Amphitheater (Seasonal Concerts/Movies) *24/7 Onsite Security *Nestled Between Rosemary & Alys Beach *Publix, Winn-Dixie, & CVS Located Just 4 Miles East on Hwy 98 *1.3 Miles of Unmarked Trails *South Walton’s Tallest Sand Dunes *No Smoking/No Pets Permitted *Minimum Age Requirement to Rent is 25 *Must be 1 Adult to Accompany Every 4 Guests Under the Age of 25 *No Parties/Events Allowed DINING/DRINKS/TREATS/SHOPPING: *Peddlers Pavillion *La Cocina *Crabby Steve’s Bar & Gulfside Restaurant *North Barrett Square *Wild Olive’s *Amavida Coffee & Tea *Raw & Juicy *George’s At Alys Beach *NEAT Please Note: Seacrest Beach does NOT allow golf carts in their community.
